source_documents: SEC Form 13F information tables identifying Rosetta Resources Inc. common stock, CUSIP 777779307
KLR Energy Acquisition Corp. Schedule 13G identifying CUSIP 49877M207 as a unit containing one Class A common share and one warrant
Rosehill Resources Schedule 13D filings identifying later CUSIPs 777385105 and 49877M108 as Class A common stock
factual_findings: SEC information tables during the canonical era identify Rosetta Resources Inc. as common stock under CUSIP 777779307.
The recorded ROSEQ CUSIPs do not describe the canonical 2010-2015 ROSE episode. They belong to the later KLR Energy Acquisition Corp./Rosehill Resources chain.

CUSIP 49877M207 was a KLR SPAC unit, while later Rosehill CUSIPs were Class A common stock; that mixed-type later chain demonstrates identity contamination and does not create a factual type transition for the canonical Rosetta episode.
cases.identity_transition_analysis: The canonical ticker/interval binds to Rosetta Resources Inc., ticker ROSE, CUSIP 777779307. The retained 777385105/49877M108/49877M207/777385204 chain is a post-canonical KLR/Rosehill identity chain and is not the canonical security. The security-type truth is therefore evaluated on Rosetta Resources, not on the contaminated later CUSIPs.
identity_cusip_defects: Recorded CUSIPs are from a later KLR/Rosehill episode rather than the canonical Rosetta Resources episode.
The contaminated later chain itself contains both a SPAC unit and Class A common-stock CUSIPs.
cases.contradiction_search: Primary-source searches found non-common unit evidence only for the later KLR security CUSIP 49877M207. SEC records for the actual canonical Rosetta Resources identity consistently identify common stock. No preferred, partnership-unit, trust-unit, warrant, right, fund, or other non-common class was found bound to Rosetta Resources ticker ROSE during the canonical interval.

source_documents: China Advanced Construction Materials Group SEC-filed issuer announcement for the 2013 reverse split/reincorporation
Huitao Technology Form 6-K documenting the China Advanced Construction Materials/Huitao identity transition
Color Star Technology Schedule 13G identifying ordinary shares, CUSIP G2287A100
Color Star Technology Form 6-K documenting a reverse split of ordinary shares and new CUSIP G2287A209
Color Star Technology Schedules 13G identifying Class A Ordinary Shares, CUSIP G2287A126
Nasdaq Trader corporate-action notice for the Color Star to Zeta Network Group name/symbol change and Class A ordinary-share CUSIP G2287A134
Zeta Network Group Schedule 13G identifying Class A Ordinary Shares, CUSIP G2287A134
Later Zeta Network Group Schedule 13G identifying post-canonical Class A Ordinary Shares, CUSIP G2287A142
factual_findings: China Advanced Construction Materials Group's SEC-filed announcement states that its common stock underwent a 1-for-12 reverse split in 2013 and continued as common stock under new CUSIP 169365202.
The Huitao/Color Star successor chain is documented as shares/ordinary shares; Color Star CUSIP G2287A100 is expressly Ordinary Shares.

Color Star's 2022 SEC filing states that the reverse split applied to ordinary shares, continued those ordinary shares under CUSIP G2287A209, and states that no preference shares were then issued and outstanding.
SEC Schedules 13G identify CUSIP G2287A126 as Class A Ordinary Shares.
Nasdaq's August 2025 corporate-action notice and an SEC Schedule 13G bind the ZNB name/symbol transition to Class A Ordinary Shares under CUSIP G2287A134.

CUSIP G2287A142 is documented as Zeta Class A Ordinary Shares only after the canonical interval and is a post-canonical identity/CUSIP-chain contaminant, not evidence of a different canonical legal type.
cases.identity_transition_analysis: The record spans reincorporations, issuer/name changes, reverse splits and CUSIP changes from China Advanced Construction Materials through Huitao/Color Star to Zeta Network Group. Authoritative records consistently describe the traded equity as common stock, ordinary shares, or Class A ordinary shares. Some retained CUSIPs are incompletely bound as standalone identifiers, and G2287A142 is demonstrably post-canonical; these are identity-chain data-quality defects. They do not create a security-type ambiguity because the documented legal class throughout the decision interval remains eligible corporate common/ordinary equity.
identity_cusip_defects: The nine-CUSIP retained chain over-aggregates multiple corporate-action/name/domicile transitions.
CUSIP G2287A142 is post-canonical: SEC evidence dates that Zeta Class A ordinary-share CUSIP to 2026, after the 2025-10-15 canonical endpoint.

CUSIP G21225100 was not independently bound to a standalone primary-source class description in this cleanup; surrounding issuer-transition evidence establishes the factual traded class as common/ordinary equity.
cases.contradiction_search: Searches specifically tested for preferred shares, units, warrants, rights, trust/partnership interests and other non-common instruments. The strongest contrary-class check is the issuer's 2022 Form 6-K, which describes the listed security as ordinary shares and states that no preference shares were issued and outstanding. No authoritative source binds a non-common instrument to the canonical listed-equity episode.

factual_findings: SEC Schedule 13G/A identifies Aptorum Group Limited CUSIP G6096M114 as Class A Ordinary Shares.
SEC Schedule 13G/A identifies Aptorum Group Ltd CUSIP G6096M106 as Class A Ordinary Shares.
SEC Form 13F data identifies CUSIP G6096M122 as Aptorum Group Limited Class A/common equity following the CUSIP transition.
Aptorum filings separately describe warrants exercisable for Class A Ordinary Shares, confirming that warrants are distinct instruments from the reviewed share class.
cases.identity_transition_analysis: All three retained CUSIPs bind to Aptorum Group's Class A ordinary-share episode across CUSIP/reverse-split changes. The terminal ticker label NIKI reflects a later issuer/name transition and is an identity-label artifact for the canonical 2024-2025 interval; it does not alter the legal type of the historical Aptorum security.
identity_cusip_defects: The canonical interval predates the later NIKI terminal ticker/name, while the retained CUSIPs identify Aptorum Group Class A ordinary shares.
cases.contradiction_search: Primary-source searches found warrants associated with Aptorum financings, but the filings expressly distinguish those warrants from the Class A Ordinary Shares represented by the reviewed CUSIPs. No preferred share, unit, trust/partnership interest, right, fund or other non-common class was found bound to the reviewed CUSIPs.
